## About the Checklist

This repository is for maintaining a checklist of the butterflies of Alaska in Darwin Core format based on the *Butterflies of Alaska* [@PhilipFerris2026].

The structure of the checklist follows guidance of @GBIF2017. 
The [`archive/checklist.csv`](archive/checklist.csv) table currently includes information from the Darwin Core

- taxon (<https://rs.gbif.org/core/dwc_taxon_2025-07-10.xml>),
- species distribution (<https://rs.gbif.org/extension/gbif/1.0/distribution_2022-02-02.xml>), and
- vernacular names (<https://rs.gbif.org/extension/gbif/1.0/vernacularname.xml>)

extensions. Terms and controlled vocabularies generally follow @DarwinCoreMaintenanceGroup2026. 
The vocabulary of `occurrenceStatus` are available from <https://rs.gbif.org/vocabulary/gbif/distribution_status_2020-07-15.xml>.
The vocabulary of `establishmentMeans` and `degreeOfEstablishment` follows  @Groometal2019.

## Notes

In addition to the single Alaskan record of *Boloria epithore* (Western Meadow Fritillary) cited by @PhilipFerris2026, a second Alaskan record has been documented [@iNaturalist2026occurrence5206387618]^[<https://gbif.org/occurrence/5206387618>], so we considered its `occurrenceStatus` to be `present` and its `establishmentMeans` to be `native`.
